---
title: "Cultural Protectionism"
date: "2009-07-20"
categories: ["Economics"]
---

[Louise Adler](http://www.theaustralian.news.com.au/story/0,25197,25796693-7583,00.html "Louise Adler") of Melbourne University Press provides a self-parody of the arguments against liberalisation of parallel book imports:

> *To borrow from John Howard, surely we should decide what books come to this country, and the manner in which they come.*

Tim Wilson makes the case for scrapping parallel import restrictions [here](http://www.ipa.org.au/publications/1684/unbinding-book-barriers-why-australia-should-scrap-parallel-import-restrictions-on-books "here").
